newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura says executives to cut ties with sokaiya.
newsitem.headline: Nomura says executives to cut ties with sokaiya.

text.p: Nomura Securities Co Ltd assured shareholders on Friday that its executives would seek to cut off ties with "sokaiya" racketeers in the wake of a payoff scandal.
"We as executives will endeavour to firmly cut ties with anti-social elements such as sokaiya," Nomura president Junichi Ujiie said in a speech to the company's annual shareholders' meeting.
His comments were relayed to reporters by Nomura officials.
Nomura said that a record 855 shareholders participated in its annual meeting on Friday, up sharply from last year's 250. The previous record was 542 marked in 1991, it said.
